newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-PEREC OPTS AGAINST 400 HURDLES IN ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PEREC OPTS AGAINST 400 HURDLES IN ATHENS.

text.p: Double Olympic champion Marie-Jose Perec of France has decided against running in the 400 metres hurdles at the world championships in Athens in August.

The 400 and 200 metres Olympic gold medal winner, who trains in California, has given up plans for a 400 metres and 400 hurdles double. She has decided to take part only in the flat race in Athens, said Friday's L'Equipe quoting the organiser of this weekend's European Cup in Munich.
It said Perec had confirmed she would run in the 200 metres in Munich but was not yet ready for the longer sprint.
